Sugar value must be a positive number.
Blood sugar status: Everything is normal. Your glucose level is within the healthy range.
Blood sugar status: Out of normal range. Please monitor and consult your doctor if this continues.
Please enter both systolic and diastolic values.
Pressure values must be positive numbers.
Blood pressure status: Everything is normal. Your blood pressure is in a healthy range.
Blood pressure status: Needs attention. Consider checking regularly and discussing with your doctor.
Please enter both weight and waist values.
Weight and waist must be positive numbers.

Weight status: Underweight. This can sometimes be related to nutritional gaps or underlying health conditions. It is recommended to consult a doctor or a nutritionist to develop a healthy, nutrient-dense eating plan.
Weight status: Everything is normal. Great job maintaining a healthy weight and lifestyle!
Weight status: Overweight. It is recommended to review your diet by reducing fast carbs and sweets, and increase physical activity, like 30 minutes of brisk walking daily.

Weight status: Obesity. Please avoid extreme or crash diets as they can harm your metabolism. It is highly recommended to consult a doctor (endocrinologist or nutritionist) for a safe and personalized weight management plan.
Waist advice: Slightly elevated risk. Consider managing your portions and staying active.
Waist advice: High risk of visceral fat accumulation. It is advised to monitor your lifestyle and consult a healthcare professional.
Waist advice: Slightly elevated risk. Monitoring your calorie intake and increasing daily movement is recommended.
Waist advice: High risk of visceral fat. It is recommended to adjust your nutrition and seek medical or professional guidance for cardiovascular health.

Age-based advice: after 40, monitor weight and waist more regularly and discuss trends with your doctor.
